newsitem.title: USA: CIENA slips in heavy trade after offering.
newsitem.headline: CIENA slips in heavy trade after offering.

text.p: CIENA Corp shares slipped slightly in very heavy trading after it completed a secondary offering of 9,110,622 shares.
The stock lost 3/16 to 45-1/16 and was one of the most heavily traded Nasdaq issues. More than three million shares had changed hands after two hours of trading.
The shares sold for $44 each in the offering. Of the total number of shares, only one million were sold by the company while 8,110,622 shares were offered by selling shareholders.
When the company filed for the offering secondary offering, it planned to sell even more shares -- 10 million -- for roughly $47.25 each.
Goldman Sachs was the lead underwriter of the offering.

"In light of the significant number of shares becoming eligible for sale on August 7, 1997, the company anticipates announcing revenues for the quarter ended July 31, 1997 on or about August 6, 1997," is said in a statement.
At the end of the second quarter ended April 30, 1997, CIENA had roughly 104.5 million shares outstanding.
